question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Tasty
solution:
The correct answer is '**Insipid**'.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Tasty**' is '**Insipid**'.
 
• **Tasty**: having a good flavour. (स्‍वादिष्‍ट, ज़ायके़दार)
 
 
• *Example: spaghetti with a **tasty** mushroom sauce...*
 
 
 
• **Insipid**: having too little taste, flavour or colour. (बेस्‍वाद या फीका, स्‍वादहीन)
 
 
• *Example: a thin, **insipid** soup was placed before us...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** Insipid.*
